paragraphs: Correct a campaign's definition — send only the fields you are changing. An omitted field keeps its value; an empty string, empty list or null clears it — except name, which a campaign always has, so clearing it is a 422. An unknown field name is rejected with 422 rather than silently ignored, so a typo can never look like a successful write. Returns the full definition as it now stands. Re-aiming costs leads. Changing target_role, target_geography, target_company_size, positive_criteria or negative_criteria is a retarget, exactly as in the app: the leads this campaign has not contacted yet are dropped and Explee searches again against the new targeting. Editing the offer or the email briefs does not — it only changes what is written to the leads still to come. Emails already sent are never affected. The rule for this endpoint: anything a person can edit on the campaign in the app, you can edit here — with the exceptions below, each of which exists because the app validates it in a second step this endpoint cannot reproduce. Read-only here: instructions and followup_instructions (the copy briefs — the app moderates them right after saving and shows you the verdict; this endpoint has no preview to show, and an unmoderated brief only fails later, at send time), target_url and reply_instructions (their own two-step save), keywords (Explee derives it; read-only in the app too) and followups (a project-level setting shared by every campaign of the project: sending the current values back is accepted, different ones are a 422). Budget has PATCH /public/api/v1/autogtm/campaigns/{campaign_id}/budget, status has start / stop. You can still SET the briefs when you create a campaign — POST /public/api/v1/autogtm/campaigns/import takes instructions, followup_instructions and language.

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Integer numbers.

parameters.name: customer_problem
parameters.description: The problem this audience has.

parameters.name: example_clients
parameters.description: Recognizable companies that fit this ICP.

parameters.name: followups
parameters.description: Read-only per campaign: the follow-up sequence is a project-level setting. Sending the current values back is accepted; different values are a 422.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language to write in: one of en-US, en-GB, de, fr, es, it, ja, pt, zh, ko, nl, id, tr, pl, ar, vi, th, ru, sv, he, hi, da, cs, ro, fi, hu, no, uk, el, sr, hr, or auto to pick per lead. Note the short form: de, not de-DE.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Campaign name.

parameters.name: negative_criteria
parameters.description: Disqualifying signals — look-alikes that are NOT a fit. Re-aims the campaign, exactly like target_geography. On a campaign built from an imported lead list (targeting_editable: false) it is saved with 200 and re-aims nothing — the uploaded list is the audience, so there is no search to re-run.

parameters.name: offer
parameters.description: What you offer this audience.

parameters.name: positive_criteria
parameters.description: Signals that qualify a company for this campaign. Re-aims the campaign, exactly like target_geography. On a campaign built from an imported lead list (targeting_editable: false) it is saved with 200 and re-aims nothing — the uploaded list is the audience, so there is no search to re-run.

parameters.name: schedule
parameters.description: Send days. Only the sub-fields you send are changed.

parameters.name: target_company_size
parameters.description: Target company size, free text (e.g. "10-200 employees"). Re-aims the campaign, exactly like target_geography.

parameters.name: target_geography
parameters.description: Target geographies, free text (e.g. "Spain, Portugal"). Re-aims the campaign: changing it drops the leads it has not contacted yet and makes Explee search again against the new targeting.

parameters.name: target_role
parameters.description: Who to reach at the prospect, by responsibility (e.g. "Head of Compliance"). Re-aims the campaign, exactly like target_geography. On a campaign built from an imported lead list (targeting_editable: false) it is saved with 200 and re-aims nothing — the uploaded list is the audience, so there is no search to re-run.
Successful Response
Invalid or missing API key. Include X-API-Key header.
Insufficient credit balance. Every request needs a positive balance, including requests that fall entirely inside the free results zone. Top up your account.
Campaign not found or not owned by your organization.
Targeting is locked: this campaign runs on your imported lead list.

Rate limit exceeded (10000/hour), concurrent limit reached (150 per organization), or free preview quota exceeded (search requests entirely within the free results zone; the quota depends on your plan).
Internal server error. Contact support if persists.
Request timeout. Please try again later.
